# templator documentation

templator is a type-safe HTML template rendering engine for Go. It wraps the
standard `html/template` package with a generic `Registry[T]`/`Handler[T]` API
so that the data you pass to a template is checked by the compiler, with
optional load-time field validation and a `go:generate` accessor generator.

Docs site: https://stdout.alesr.me/templator-docs/
Library repository: https://github.com/alesr/templator
